groupings.title: Create e-invoices
groupings.description: Generate validated ZUGFeRD, Factur-X or XRechnung (EN 16931) with invoice-api.xhub.io, from conversation data or from an existing PDF invoice.

groupings.title: Read and check
groupings.description: Extract the data of an incoming e-invoice and report validation errors before you book or pay it.

groupings.title: Invoice layout
groupings.description: Rebuild your own invoice design as an invoice-api template, so the e-invoice looks like your current invoices.
